name: animate-grid
title: 3D Hover Grid
blurb: Card grid that tilts cards on hover with 3D perspective and glow.
description: Renders a 4x4 grid where each card scales and glows on hover. Hover spreads glow to adjacent cards using CSS transforms and filter effects.
use_when: Portfolio galleries, feature grids, or product showcases where 3D depth is desired.
avoid_when: Motion-sensitive users; dense layouts; small screens (4x4 doesn't adapt).
a11y: Static grid with hover effects only. No keyboard navigation beyond card focus.
